# KSRE Bookstore

> Kansas State Research and Extension Bookstore providing 1,800+ educational publications and materials for 4-H youth development programs, animal science projects, and youth engagement across Kansas.

The KSRE Bookstore is the primary resource hub for Kansas 4-H members, leaders, and educators seeking project guides, achievement pins, livestock materials, and educational resources. The collection spans youth development topics from animal science and citizenship to entrepreneurship and environmental science.

## Key Topics

- 4-H Youth Development
- Achievement Pins
- Animal Science Projects
- 4-H Clubs
- Beef Cattle
- Dairy Cattle
- Cloverbuds
- Project Guides
- Educational Materials
- Youth Programs
- KSRE
- Kansas State University
- Citizenship
- Entrepreneurship
- Environmental Science

## 4-H Core Programs

- [4-H Youth Development](https://bookstore.ksre.ksu.edu/topic/4-h-youth-development): 4-H Youth Development topic page with educational resources and project guides
- [4-H Clubs](https://bookstore.ksre.ksu.edu/topic/4-h-youth-development/clubs): 4-H club resources and guides for club officers and youth development
- [Cloverbuds](https://bookstore.ksre.ksu.edu/topic/4-h-youth-development/cloverbuds): Kansas 4-H Cloverbuds early childhood program guides and meeting plans
- [Exploring 4-H](https://bookstore.ksre.ksu.edu/topic/4-h-youth-development/exploring-4-h): 4-H Exploring project introduction with educational activities

## Animal Science Projects

- [Animal Science 4-H Projects](https://bookstore.ksre.ksu.edu/topic/4-h-youth-development/4-h-animal-science-projects): 4-H Animal Science project materials including dairy and beef resources
- [Beef Cattle](https://bookstore.ksre.ksu.edu/topic/4-h-youth-development/beef-cattle): 4-H Beef Cattle project educational publications and livestock materials
- [Dairy Cattle](https://bookstore.ksre.ksu.edu/topic/4-h-youth-development/dairy-cattle): 4-H Dairy Cattle project educational materials and livestock resources
- [Dairy Goat](https://bookstore.ksre.ksu.edu/topic/4-h-youth-development/dairy-goat): 4-H Dairy Goat project materials and achievement pin resources
- [Dog](https://bookstore.ksre.ksu.edu/topic/4-h-youth-development/dog): 4-H Dog project guides for care, training, and show rules

## Achievement Pins & Awards

- [Achievement Pins](https://bookstore.ksre.ksu.edu/topic/4-h-youth-development/project-achievement-pins): 4-H achievement pins for recognizing member program accomplishments
- [Awards](https://bookstore.ksre.ksu.edu/topic/4-h-youth-development/awards): 4-H awards and achievement pins for youth recognition programs

## Life Skills & Personal Development

- [Citizenship](https://bookstore.ksre.ksu.edu/topic/4-h-youth-development/citizenship): 4-H Citizenship project materials and civic engagement resources
- [Communications](https://bookstore.ksre.ksu.edu/topic/4-h-youth-development/communications): 4-H Communications project materials for public speaking and skills
- [Entrepreneurship](https://bookstore.ksre.ksu.edu/topic/4-h-youth-development/entrepreneurship): 4-H Entrepreneurship project lesson materials and business skill resources
- [Clothing](https://bookstore.ksre.ksu.edu/topic/4-h-youth-development/clothing): 4-H Clothing project guides for sewing and textile education

## Science & Technology Projects

- [Environmental Science](https://bookstore.ksre.ksu.edu/topic/4-h-youth-development/environmental-science): 4-H Environmental Science project resources on soil and water quality
- [Energy Management](https://bookstore.ksre.ksu.edu/topic/4-h-youth-development/energy-management): 4-H Energy Management and small engines project educational materials
- [Entomology](https://bookstore.ksre.ksu.edu/topic/4-h-youth-development/entomology): 4-H Entomology project supplies and insect education materials
- [Exploring Your Environment](https://bookstore.ksre.ksu.edu/topic/4-h-youth-development/exploring-your-environment): 4-H environment exploration and STEM achievement pin resources

- [Home - KSRE Bookstore](https://bookstore.ksre.ksu.edu): K-State Research and Extension Bookstore homepage with 1,800+ publications
